```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(estimatr)
library(tidyverse)
library(randomizr)

```

## Part (3)

```{r, echo = T, include = T, warning = F}

data <- read.csv("green_study.csv")
q6data <- na.omit(data)

ITT <- mean(q6data$Vote98[q6data$Contact == 1]) - 
       mean(q6data$Vote98[q6data$Contact == 0])
print(ITT)

ITT_D <- nrow(q6data[q6data$Contacted == 1,]) / 
         nrow(q6data[q6data$Contact == 1,])
print(ITT_D)

CACE <- ITT / ITT_D
print(CACE)

model_cace <- iv_robust(Vote98 ~ Contacted | Contact, data = q6data) %>% tidy()
print(model_cace)

```

## Part (4)

```{r, echo = T, include = T, warning = F}

# setting seed

set.seed(20251101)

# regressing treatment on our covariates of interest

q6_model <- lm_robust(Contact ~ Age + Party + Vote96, data = q6data)

# extracting the actual f-statistic

q6_fstat <- q6_model$fstatistic[1]

print(q6_fstat)

# conducting randomisation inference on the f-statistic to obtain a p-value

# declaring random assignment procedure

q6_declaration <- declare_ra(nrow(q6data), 
                             m = nrow(q6data[q6data$Contact == 1,]))

print(q6_declaration)

# creating empty vector to store results of for loop

q6_estimates <- numeric(50000)

# calculating f-statistic for pre-test, looping over every permutation

for (i in 1:50000) {
  
q6data$ri <- conduct_ra(q6_declaration)
ri_model <- lm(ri ~ Age + Party + Vote96, data = q6data)
q6_estimates[i] <- summary(ri_model)$fstatistic[1]
}

# calculating the p-value

q6_pvalue <- mean(q6_estimates >= q6_fstat)

print(q6_pvalue)

```

## Part (5)

Yes, I would estimate the CACE differently in this scenario. The researchers' decision rule has meant that they have conducted a restricted randomization, which produces differential probabilities of assignment to conditions. To address this, CACE must be estimated using an inverse probability weighed estimator.

```{r, echo = T, include = T, warning = F}

# creating a function to conduct restricted randomisation

restricted_ra <- function(d, a, b, c, m) {
   while (TRUE) {
     
    Z = complete_ra(nrow(d), m)
    f <- lm_robust(as.formula(paste("Z ~", 
                                    paste(c(a, b, c), collapse = " + "))), 
                                    data = d)$fstatistic

if (1 - pf(q = f[1], df1 = f[2], df2 = f[3]) > 0.10) {
return(Z)
    
    
    }
  }
}

# setting seed

set.seed(20251101)

# conducting iterations of restricted randomisation

sim_matrix <- replicate(10000, restricted_ra(d = q6data, 
                                             a = "Age", 
                                             b = "Party", 
                                             c = "Vote96", 
                                             m = sum(q6data$Contact)))

# picking a random number to select the column that will be the realisation  

number <- sample(1:10000,1,FALSE)

q6data$Z <- sim_matrix[,number]

# calculating ipws

zdeclaration <- declare_ra(permutation_matrix = sim_matrix)

print(zdeclaration)

q6data$weights <- 1 / obtain_condition_probabilities(zdeclaration, q6data$Z)

# calculating weighted CACE using ivrobust

z_cace <- iv_robust(Vote98 ~ Contacted | Contact, weights = weights, data = q6data) %>% tidy()
print(z_cace)

```
